threads.body: [General] This generated workflow still passes `${{ secrets.COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}` to the agent at line 941 and retains the secret checks/manifest entry. As a result, granting this permission does not move this runnable lock workflow to the organization token; deleting the old secret will break Copilot authentication. Regenerate the lock workflow so the Copilot token comes from `${{ github.token }}` and the PAT is no longer required.
threads.hunk:
@@ -417,6 +417,7 @@ jobs:
     environment: protected
     permissions:
       contents: read
+      copilot-requests: write

replies.body:
No code change.

Already resolved in the current head: the agent uses github.token, and COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN is no longer required as a secret.
